استطبنا (form X)
# اِسْتَطَبْنَا (istaṭabnā) /is.ta.tˤab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَطَابَ (istaṭāba)
# اُسْتُطِبْنَا (ustuṭibnā) /us.tu.tˤib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَطَابَ (istaṭāba)
